# Streamweld 1.0.0

This release fixes stream continuation, client recovery, and Kubernetes drain
and rollout behavior. The HTTP/SSE protocol and public TypeScript APIs follow
semantic versioning. Kubernetes `v1alpha1` resources remain experimental.

## Changes

- Preserve short continuation output and tool-call boundaries when a backend
  fails. Bound continuation buffers and keep estimated token totals marked as
  estimates.
- Stop retrying duplicate-only replay indefinitely. Apply the client stop
  timeout to the full response and close failed reader connections.
- Preserve the AI SDK adapter's configured model and detach its reader when a
  response cannot be converted.
- Accept Kubernetes HTTP drain hooks, bound the complete drain fanout, and
  reject invalid or empty CLI drain acknowledgements.
- Prevent memory-mode proxies and standalone Redis from serving independent
  journals during an upgrade.

## Upgrade from 0.1.0

No wire-format or stream cursor migration is required. Update both npm packages
together if you use the AI SDK adapter.

Memory-mode proxies and embedded Redis now use `Recreate` updates. Plan for a
brief interruption; memory journals and Redis without persistence lose retained
streams on replacement. Redis-backed proxies keep rolling updates.

Node.js 22.12+ is required to build the repository. Published TypeScript packages
continue to support Node.js 20+.

## Install

```sh
helm upgrade --install streamweld oci://ghcr.io/satwiksps/charts/streamweld \
  --namespace streamweld-system --create-namespace \
  --version 1.0.0 --wait --timeout 3m

npm install @streamweld/client@1.0.0
```

For Vercel AI SDK v5:

```sh
npm install @streamweld/ai-sdk@1.0.0 ai@^5
```

See the [adapter setup notes](https://github.com/satwiksps/streamweld/blob/v1.0.0/packages/ai-sdk/README.md)
for React, strict TypeScript checks, and the tested dependency override. One
low-severity upstream AI SDK advisory remains.

Binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows are attached with SHA-256 checksums.
Container images are `ghcr.io/satwiksps/streamweld-proxy:1.0.0` and
`ghcr.io/satwiksps/streamweld-operator:1.0.0`.

Run `streamweldctl doctor` against your exact backend/model/tokenizer before
enabling migration. Deterministic tests do not establish GPU model compatibility.

[Documentation](https://streamweld.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)
